text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fresh, green scent wafts over on the
breeze. I idly turn towards it,
only to spot
Zephyr drifting in with the early-summer
air.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Were you called here by the dry
breeze too? It's a refreshing
change from
all the humidity.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm afraid... the wind makes no
promises. I'm not sure where best
to enjoy
this breeze, so I'm still searching.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, off it goes again. Pardon me, Trainer,
I must be away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The wind makes no promises"... So
basically, she doesn't really have
any
plans, I guess? She must be wandering
around campus on another
one of her
strolls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But before long...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Zephyyyr! Zephyr, do you hear meee?
...Oooh, where on earth could
she be?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Oh, hang on... You're her trainer,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind helping me find her? I'm
taking RSVPs for a class
get-together, but
I haven't been able to pin Zephyr down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering the direction Zephyr headed
off in, I suggest that she
might have gone
to the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr? Yeah, she was just here. But then
she wandered off to "feel
the evening air"
or something.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Whew... What a lovely evening breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This rooftop is the best place on campus
to enjoy the winds. It's
especially nice at
dusk this time of year—so cool and
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's out enjoying the evening air, I bet
she's at the place she
showed me, way
back when!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Oh, yup, Zephyr's just over—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, where'd she go?! I swear, she was
here just a second ago!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh, come ooon! How do we keep
missing her?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr drifts around campus,
elusive as the wind through
our fingers.
Buuut, while we're up high, I might as well
scan around
for—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
We finally found you! We've been looking
everywhere, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, you look like you've been swept
around by a summer squall.
What did you
need me for?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm quite sorry to have troubled you
both. I thought I'd already
communicated
that the wind makes no promises...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I cannot say where it will lead, so I did not
wish to brew storms in
clear skies, you see.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr being cryptic is nothing new, but it
slowly dawns on me that
she said the
whole "wind makes no promises" thing
when I asked
about her plans...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So it wasn't literally about the wind! She meant that she herself couldn't make any promises about her schedule.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Correct. I cannot say which way the wind
will blow.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Which way... the wind will blow? Oh! So
you're saying, your schedule's
not locked
in yet?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fair enough, you've got your training to
consider too. No problem!
Thanks for
letting me know, and thank you too,
Trainer, for the help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...It's fine. I don't particularly like weighing
myself down, so to speak.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I find the time I share with
others to be quite refreshing...
but so too
do I enjoy time alone, catching my breath
in the quiet
summer airstreams.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind is ever shifting, never the same
as last you felt it. I wish to
leave some
flexibility, just as a weather vane can pivot
on the wind's
whim.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...More simply put, I want to do what feels
natural in the moment. I
cannot know what
tomorrow will bring—blustering chills, or
sunny lulls.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I just... want to spend time my own
way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just like the wind... free to change my
course...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Avoiding promises to live loose like the
wind... It's a unique
philosophy, but it
really fits her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although... I wonder what exactly she
means by "free" and "natural."
As her
trainer, I feel like I should know...
